calibration.fit: SOURCE_VALIDATION out-of-fold for selection; final mapping fitted on full SOURCE_VALIDATION after selection
calibration.reliability: 10 fixed equal-width bins plus reliability diagram

fusion.historical_candidate: FROZEN_CT_EQUAL / CT_equal, CODE+TEXT probability late fusion 0.5/0.5; historical evidence only
fusion.multimodal_campaign_comparator: feature-level concatenation after modality-specific SOURCE-TRAIN fitting

hyperparameters: nested chronological SOURCE development only; fixed search space must be added with XGB/LGBM implementations before execution; TARGET never participates

imbalance.baseline: natural prevalence; no resampling; no class weighting
imbalance.conditional_sensitivity: SOURCE-TRAIN-only class weighting, separately identified and frozen before authorization

lifecycle.SOURCE_TRAIN: fit preprocessing, representations, model and imbalance transformations
lifecycle.SOURCE_VALIDATION: hyperparameters, calibrator policy and fixed threshold development only
lifecycle.TARGET_FINAL_TEST: one authorized inference/evaluation after manifest and access gate pass

preprocessing.categorical: source-train-fitted encoder with explicit unknown category
preprocessing.numeric: median imputation then zero-variance removal then Z-score using source-train mu/sigma
preprocessing.outliers: no removal or winsorization in baseline
preprocessing.sparse: preserve sparse representation; do not center
preprocessing.text: source-train-fitted TF-IDF; vocabulary/IDF never fit on validation or target

campaign_operational_rqs: RQ1 multimodal versus unimodal predictive performance
RQ7 explanatory evidence of complementary modality contributions
research_questions.existing_general_rq: How does integrating a multimodal and explainable framework combining code, process, and text influence precision, reliability, and interpretability of defect prediction?
research_questions.reconciliation: The seven campaign RQs operationalize, and do not overwrite, the repository's general RQ.

conditional_secondary: leave-one-dataset-out when at least four independently compatible datasets exist
topology.source: historical TRAIN/VALIDATION from all non-target projects
topology.target: new post-boundary materialization for held-out project

xai.purpose: explain complementary modality contribution, not decorate or optimize
